activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle and toaster
Getting dressed and reviewing the day's patient schedule on the computer at the desk
Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating clinical records
Taking a lunch break at the hospital
Continuing clinical work, patient rounds and handover preparation
Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker and range hood
Clearing the table and loading dishes into the dishwasher
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
Winding down under the air conditioner, checking the phone before sleep
